title: The Late Silence
author: Mara Eriksen
blurb: Felix Voss, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
